newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.056pts to 99.637.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.056pts to 99.637.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.056 points in Tuesday's trading to 99.637, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.485 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell 0.068 points to 95.867 points, the bank said, while the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.412 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 3.419 points to 1,201.795.
